WITH year_total AS (
    SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
           c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
           c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
           c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
           c_login AS customer_login,
           c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
           d_year AS dyear,
           SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total,
           's' AS sale_type
    FROM customer
    INNER JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year IN (1998, 1999)
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
           c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
           c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
           c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
           c_login AS customer_login,
           c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
           d_year AS dyear,
           SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total,
           'w' AS sale_type
    FROM customer
    INNER JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year IN (1998, 1999)
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
)
SELECT customer_id,
       customer_first_name,
       customer_last_name,
       customer_email_address
FROM (
    SELECT customer_id,
           MAX(customer_first_name) FILTER (WHERE sale_type = 's' AND dyear = 1999) AS customer_first_name,
           MAX(customer_last_name) FILTER (WHERE sale_type = 's' AND dyear = 1999) AS customer_last_name,
           MAX(customer_email_address) FILTER (WHERE sale_type = 's' AND dyear = 1999) AS customer_email_address,
           MAX(year_total) FILTER (WHERE sale_type = 's' AND dyear = 1998) AS s_firstyear_total,
           MAX(year_total) FILTER (WHERE sale_type = 's' AND dyear = 1999) AS s_secyear_total,
           MAX(year_total) FILTER (WHERE sale_type = 'w' AND dyear = 1998) AS w_firstyear_total,
           MAX(year_total) FILTER (WHERE sale_type = 'w' AND dyear = 1999) AS w_secyear_total
    FROM year_total
    WHERE dyear IN (1998, 1999)
    GROUP BY customer_id
) AS pivoted
WHERE s_firstyear_total > 0
  AND w_firstyear_total > 0
  AND CASE WHEN w_firstyear_total > 0 THEN w_secyear_total / w_firstyear_total ELSE 0.0 END
      > CASE WHEN s_firstyear_total > 0 THEN s_secyear_total / s_firstyear_total ELSE 0.0 END
ORDER BY customer_id, customer_first_name, customer_last_name, customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
